description: A single-story brick ranch home on a quiet residential street in Killeen. Four bedrooms and two full bathrooms are arranged around a bright living room, with the kitchen opening to a breakfast nook. The primary suite has a bay window, a walk-in closet and its own bath, and the back yard is fully fenced.
